items.text: Finalized: incorporated all five round-2 answers into the conclusion. Summary now states the contract concretely instead of TBD; Finding 1 adds the eager sandbox-creation default (d3=A); Finding 2 was rewritten to include the apply-timing state machine for manualReview=true (d2=B, with the user-supplied note that approval can come from GCT, agent-manager, or workspace-sandbox) and the provenance schema additions table (d1=A runOutcome on ProvenanceRunGroup, d4=B per-file state on ProvenanceFile); Finding 3 was extended to name the three approval surfaces and the workspace-sandbox sandbox-persistence-beyond-run-end responsibility; Finding 4 M4 was tightened to enumerate the schema additions; Finding 5 added a ninth behavior for manualReview deferred-apply and scoped the validation gate to agent-manager UI + swarm-manager queue (d5=B); Finding 6 reflows the sequencing to put GCT schema hardening before the validation step and narrows the rollout surface.

Actions section was uncommented and finalized as 8 items: 4 Update backlog item actions on existing initiative members (the four execute/fix members), 1 upstream Update on execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening (the load-bearing schema work for d1 and d4), 1 self-Update on this research item to fix M5 stale paths, and 2 Update document actions for the AUDITABILITY_CONTRACT.md mirror and initiative context refresh. Initiative-scope review section was added confirming no Delete or initiative-level Update is required: all five existing members remain valid; depends_on is correct; priority unchanged.

Readiness scored 3/3 across all five dimensions. Problem clarity: the research question and contract goals are unambiguously stated. Scope: in/out distinctions are explicit (protected-mode, undo, cron+CLI flip, sandbox-GC TTL all out of scope and named). Approach: contract decisions are anchored to specific decision IDs and code sites. Testable: Finding 5 lists nine concrete behaviors with named gating surfaces. Risk awareness: limitations enumerate the manualReview sandbox-persistence lifecycle change as the most consequential follow-on detail and note the cron/CLI coverage gap at flip time.

One genuinely deferred detail remains, captured as a Limitation rather than a blocking gap: the garbage-collection rule for abandoned manualReview=true sandboxes (TTL, operator timeout, etc.) is left to execute/agent-manager-sandbox-auto-apply-defaults to specify during implementation. This is appropriate to defer because the contract only mandates persistence-until-decision; the exact GC heuristic is an implementation tuning decision, not a contract decision.

plan_updates: Conclusion was rewritten to remove all TBD/anticipated language and reflect the locked round-2 answers as committed contract: eager sandbox creation (d3=A), deferred apply under manualReview with three approval surfaces (d2=B + user note), runOutcome on ProvenanceRunGroup (d1=A), per-file state on ProvenanceFile with GCT filtering by state=pending-review (d4=B), and validation gating restricted to agent-manager UI + swarm-manager queue (d5=B). The Actions section was uncommented and grew from 7 anticipated items to 8 finalized items, adding an upstream action on execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening to own the schema additions. Readiness moved from (3,3,2,2,2) on round 2 to (3,3,3,3,3) on round 3.
